punareti.p: [ puna + eti ] (kri) CL=10 Comes again.

punaridhāgata.p: [ puna + idhāgata ] (ti) CL=10 The one who comes this human realm again.

punarutta.p: [ puna + utta, punarutta-saṃ ] (ti) CL=10 That which is said again.
